segments.en: Near the end of the month, Alex handles a more professional task. As the project becomes more professional, Alex gives a clear update and checks the risks. Alex checks "deployment" and "monitoring" before making a decision and explains the possible risk. In the discussion, Alex uses "Today I'd like to present ..." and "The goal of this project is ..." to clarify the goal, timing, and next step. Finally, Alex documents "release branch" and "deployment approval" so another teammate can review the work later. The work is not perfect, but the update is clear, careful, and useful.
